headline: Expensive: Beef has "soared" by 28.4% since the end of 2024
summary: Beef prices have risen 28.4% since the end of 2024 in Greece. Reduced European production, more expensive imports and higher farming costs are cited as the drivers.
why: Beef is a major food commodity whose prices depend on livestock supply, feed costs, and trade flows. Higher input and import costs feed through to consumer food inflation.
